provenClassicStorageBoundary: MajorMUD retained Worldgroup DFA context and distinct insert/update/delete operations
reforgedOrdering: ascending configured order then canonical participant id
reforgedTransactionPolicy: commit failure rolls back committed rollback-capable participants
safeFallback: Keep Reforged coordination deterministic but do not claim its order or rollback as Classic. Fail closed when exact Classic Player/world order, Buffer-data participants, transaction grouping, or shutdown-save semantics are required.
remainingNativeDependencies: exact MajorMUD Player/world save participant ordering
exact native Buffer data participant/record-family mapping
excludedNativeDependencies: exact crash-log byte format and replay algorithm are tracked under native error/recovery rather than ordinary save coordination
